items.headline: Structural Incompatibility of Differentiable Sorting and Within-Vector Rank Normalization
items.summary:
arXiv:2512.22587v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We show that differentiable sorting and ranking operators are structurally incompatible with within-vector rank normalization. We formalize admissibility through monotone invariance (C1), batch independence (C2), and a rank-space stability condition (C3).
